waivers.verdict: Move Lamar Jackson to IR for free. Add Brenton Strange over Juwan Johnson at backup TE for $2 — a clear upgrade. Jacksonville's defense is worth grabbing over Chicago's, but for $0 after Wednesday's run, not a bid tonight. Nothing else on the wire clears the bar.

lineup.verdict: No changes. Jackson's Out closes Thursday's close call — Bryce Young stays at SUPER_FLEX. Rest of the lineup holds as set.

trades.verdict: Decline sweeneyb's Keenan Allen-for-Cousins offer. Send annaf23 Cousins for Brock Bowers instead: it projects better in every window, still comes out ahead if Lamar never returns, and costs about 2 points if Bowers got hurt.

inactives.verdict: Hold — every starter is active; no pivot needed.

actions.name: Lamar Jackson
actions.why: Jackson is Out and IR-eligible; moving him frees your last bench slot for nothing.

actions.name: Brenton Strange
actions.why: Strange is playing nearly every snap with rising targets; Johnson's role has shrunk to single-digit snaps and one catch over his last three games.

actions.message: Cousins for Bowers? You're starting Watson and McKee in a superflex with 6-pt pass TDs. Cousins is averaging 24 a game and would start for you every week, and you still have LaPorta at TE.

evidence.note: Bowers was limited in practice Oct 21 (hamstring/calf), then played Week 7. He has played 84% of snaps over his last three games. His September knee scope cost him Weeks 1-2 only.

actions.why: Bowers starts over Kraft (14 a week vs 9). Cousins sits on my bench but would start at QB for them over McKee. Worst case if Bowers got hurt: about 2-3 points of lost QB cover.

case.starts: Brock Bowers starts over Tucker Kraft at TE
case.need: TE: you have 2 — not thin · gives QB depth (you have 3, start 2)
case.cost: gives Kirk Cousins — 0 starters, 1 bench · no FAAB
case.asks: annaf23 starts Brock Bowers — one of 2 TEs they carry · asks them to bench a starter for bench pieces
case.points: +4.6 this week · +42.4 rest of season · +11 playoffs
